translations.web: “ ‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.
